case_number: 2025 INSC 245; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos. 5517-5519 of 2024)

parties.petitioner: Rupa And Co. Limited and Another

summary: Mandamus enforcement vs mediation; High Court contempt jurisdiction; State's non-compliance with land conveyance order; mediation imposed without consent improper; prior arbitrariness and violation of Article 14 established; Cabinet's market-value demand set aside; High Court's mediation direction untenable; State's conduct amounts to aggravated contempt.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order setting mediation set aside; High Court directed to proceed with contempt proceedings; State directed to comply with original mandamus for conveyance as per 2011 allotment terms.
